newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS - MARKET RETREATS THOUGH TRADE THIN.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - MARKET RETREATS THOUGH TRADE THIN.

text.p: Dutch option trade was quiet on Wednesday, and dealers said there was no atmosphere of panic although the call-put ratio on the AEX index stocks dipped below one for the first time in weeks.
"The ratio is at 0.86, and anywhere under one, the market is supposed to be negative," one dealer said.
He added that this correction was not unusual given the recent rise of the stocks and based on small volume anyway.
"I don't expect the total number of contracts traded to exceed 100,000 today, unless we get big surprises from the U.S. jobless claims," he said.
